<function name="CapabilitiesRemove" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Remove a certain capability.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="capabilities" type="number">Capabilities to remove, see <page>Enums/CAP</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Removes the CAP_USE_SHOT_REGULATOR capability, if the NPC has it.</description>
	<code>self:CapabilitiesRemove(CAP_USE_SHOT_REGULATOR)</code>

</example>
